title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.1-rc.9
summary: Restore compact Other Options with hover help and reduce tab-opening layout work. Keep RC8 transfer preferences and installation controls.
changes: Remove the separate description/default row and nested table for every option. Move option help and defaults into tooltips, and compact the keyboard-shortcut rows.
Update wrapping constraints on size changes instead of inside the layout pass, reducing repeated work when Other Options becomes visible.
Remove default text entirely from Two rows, Start with Windows, and machine-to-IP mappings. Keep expanded mapping instructions visible, including an example and advice for changing IP addresses.
Keep hover help available for disabled options through their parent controls. Preserve all saved values, transfer behavior, installation controls, and keyboard assignments.
Check compact layout at the original window size, repeated tab-opening responsiveness, disabled-option help, and larger text in Windows UI tests.
testing: Open Other Options repeatedly and confirm the opening lag is gone. Check the compact page at your normal display scale, then resize it.
Hover over options for descriptions and defaults. Two rows and Start with Windows should have descriptions but no default text.

Disable Share Clipboard and hover over the disabled Allow file transfers option; its tooltip should explain the dependency. Restore clipboard sharing and confirm your saved transfer choice is preserved.
Open IP Mappings and check the visible instructions and example, with no default label for the mappings field.
Confirm RC8 receiving-folder, automatic transfer-window closing, shortcuts, and Installation settings still retain your choices.
known_limitations: Real Windows Explorer, physical display scaling, startup/uninstall, and two-PC behavior still need the manual checks above; automated tests cannot replace them.

Receiving-folder and automatic-close preferences belong to each PC. Changing the folder affects new durable drag/drop transfers only; existing jobs and legacy clipboard file copying keep their prior destinations.

The receiving folder must be an accessible ordinary local directory. Linked directories and unavailable drives are rejected. No overwrite/merge, protocol, concurrency, speed, service, or automatic-update behavior is added.
Use the same RC on both PCs for consistent Settings. RC6/RC7 protocol-2 transfers remain compatible; older EXEs may discard the new preference fields if they rewrite the same preferences file.
Full-speed Wi-Fi transfers can still cause mouse lag. Offline temporary data can only be cleaned when the peer reconnects.
